text:
anna: Noticed onboarding latency spike this morning when bench jobs ran inline with smoke checks. We should consider separating fast acceptance from deep benches.

devin: Yep. Pipeline today: ingest -> lightweight-smoke -> full-bench -> kv-compat. Full-bench blocks smoke, causing user-visible wait.

marta: Also watch quantized variantsfast checks can miss decode-mode differences if we only validate top-1.

kevin: If we split, what's the infra delta? storage/workers? numbers plz.

anna: Proposal: fork into two lanes post-ingest: "fast-accept" (0-10s, CPU or tiny GPU) for signatures, basic decode sanity, smoke prompts; and "deep-bench" (async) for perf, golden diffs. Fast-accept returns admission token; deep-bench emits report + compatibility flags later.

sam: Fast-accept needs a minimal manifest: model-arch, kv-schema, golden_prompts zip, accept thresholds. Example manifest snippet:
```
name: m-example
arch: llama2
kv_schema: v1
golden_prompts: s3://onboard/gold/abcd.zip
fast_checks:
  - smoke_decode
  - embedding_dim_check
  - kv_roundtrip
accept_thresholds:
  perplexity_delta: 20
  decode_confidence: 0.75
```

devin: Make manifest pluggable: `fast_checks` list so fast-accept is extensible.

marta: For quantized builds include `quantize_mode` and per-op `numeric_tolerance`. If missing, require manual review.

kevin: Rough cost: two fleets. Fast-accept on small nodes, deep-bench on GPUs. Ballpark +7-10% infra. S3 retention (keep latest 3 golden bundles) ~ $40-80/mo per active model.

anna: Operationally: gate route creation on fast-accept only. If deep-bench later fails, mark `quarantine` and notify owners. Provide opt-in strict gating to block route creation until deep-bench success for teams that require it.

build-bot: CI: patched intake-lambda to emit `accept_token` and `bench_job_id`. Prototype smoke-suite runner queued.

sam: Rollout: behind feature flag, pilot low-risk models, monitor latency + false-positives for 2 wks, then default.

devin: Tradeoff: eventual consistency expectations. Docs and API should make async nature explicit.

marta: Add cheap KV smoke: `kv_put/get` with ~2MB payload to catch shape/serialization early.

anna: I'll draft RFC + manifest schema PR and prototype fast-accept job in 48h. Link (WIP): https://internal.redwood/inbox/onboard-parallel-lanes

kevin: If Anna posts infra numbers I'll budget it. :+1:

sam: tagging @platform-team for ops integration.

devin: tl;dr: split fast acceptance from deep benches, manifest-driven checks, quantized tolerances, opt-in strict gating.
